name: Phone Number
description:
A phone field with a country list and flags that formats and checks numbers for every country.

Countries: flags, a searchable list, an initial country (or the browser's), only some countries, and countries listed first. Typing + and a country code picks the country. Numbers: formatted while typing as each country writes them, checked with Google's libphonenumber rules for length and kind (mobile, landline), and stored in one format: E.164 (+447400123456), international or national. Feedback: a hint under the field with the kind of number and the country, or what is wrong (too short, too long, not a mobile number). Value Required and invalid numbers are reported before the page is submitted, and checked again on the server.

Live demo: https://oracleapex.com/ords/r/aamirkhanz/plugins/phone-number (user demo, password Demo).

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins: https://www.techrevx.com
